info.name: Gazebo - Hardware Devices
info.description:
# Gazebo Hardware Devices

Estate register for Zebra TC22F scanner guns (`hw_device`, `hw_device_event`, `hw_device_post`, `hw_device_message`).

Warehouse guns send `X-Device-Serial`. Admin PCs omit it.

People use sticker **code** (`GUN-03`). Device photos live as Instagram-style posts (`cover_url` on the device card is the latest post).

Live presence: guns `POST /hardware/heartbeat/` every ~15s. Admin cards use `presence` (`online` / `idle` / `offline`) and `last_screen`. Admin popups go to `hw_device_message` and ride back on the next heartbeat.

Seeded unit: **GUN-01** / serial `26202524703110` / BT `BSD01_Gazeboo_cloud`.

## Routes
`GET|POST /hardware/devices/`, `GET|PATCH /hardware/devices/:id/`, `GET /hardware/usage/`, `GET /hardware/feed/`, `GET|POST /hardware/devices/:id/posts/`, `DELETE /hardware/devices/:id/posts/:post_id/`, `POST /hardware/heartbeat/`, `GET|POST /hardware/devices/:id/messages/`, `POST /hardware/messages/:id/ack/`

`:id` is `GUN-03` **or** the hardware serial.

## Auth
1. Run **Login** in Gazebo - RBAC Users (`POST /auth/login/`)
2. Copy `data.id_token` into `{{id_token}}`
3. List / get / feed / post / heartbeat / ack — any signed-in user
4. Create / patch device / usage / send message — IT or any Admin area

## Envelope
Success: `{ "status": "success", "message": "...", "data": ... }`
Error: `{ "status": "error", "message": "...", "data": null }`

## Vars
`{{base_url}}`, `{{id_token}}`, `{{device_code}}`, `{{user_id}}`, `{{post_id}}`, `{{message_id}}`, `{{device_serial}}`

item.name: Scanner guns
item.description:
Physical TC22F guns used on the warehouse floor.

**Tables:** `hw_device`, `hw_device_event`

**Vars:** `{{id_token}}`, `{{device_code}}`, `{{user_id}}`

Gun clients also send `X-Device-Serial` on `/auth/login/` and `/stock/*` (not required for this folder).

request.description:
### List devices

`GET /hardware/devices/`

Any signed-in user. Returns every scanner gun (sticker code, serial, who should pick it up, last seen). Filter by home warehouse or assigned user when handing out guns at the start of a shift.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | no | Home warehouse (`8` Unit 2, `2` Unit 11) |
| `assigned_user_id` | no | RBAC user currently allocated this gun |

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Devices fetched successfully.`

`data[]`:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | Sticker / barcode (`GUN-01`) |
| `serial` | Zebra serial, or null until the gun phones home |
| `nickname` | BT name, e.g. `BSD01_Gazeboo_cloud` |
| `assigned_user_id` | Who should pick this gun up |
| `cover_url` | Latest post photo (presigned, ~1h) or null |
| `post_count` | Number of feed posts |
| `last_user_id` | Who last used it |
| `last_ip` | Last Wi-Fi IP (e.g. `172.16.0.224`) |
| `last_screen` | App screen last reported on heartbeat |
| `presence` | `online` (< 30s), `idle` (< 5 min), `offline` |
| `status` | `active`, `repair`, or `retired` |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | List returned |
| 401 | Not signed in |

### Get device

`GET /hardware/devices/:id/`

Any signed-in user. `:id` is the sticker code (`GUN-01`) or the hardware serial (`26202524703110`). Use this after scanning the sticker barcode on the gun body.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `GUN-03` or Zebra serial |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Device fetched successfully.`

`data`: one device object (same fields as list), including `identity_json` from USB/ADB enroll.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Found |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 404 | Unknown code or serial |

### Register device

`POST /hardware/devices/`

IT or any Admin area. Pre-register a gun before it is on USB, so you can print sticker `GUN-03` and hang it on the rack. Leave `serial` empty until the gun first logs in, or set it from the Zebra label / ADB.

Omit `code` to auto-assign the next `GUN-nn`.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | no | Sticker code `GUN-03`. Auto `GUN-nn` if omitted |
| `serial` | no | Zebra serial (unique when set) |
| `nickname` | no | Human / BT name |
| `model` | no | Defaults to `TC22F` |
| `home_location_id` | no | Home warehouse |
| `assigned_user_id` | no | Who should pick it up |
| `status` | no | `active` (default), `repair`, `retired` |
| `identity_json` | no | Optional ADB dump |

### Response body

`message`: `Device registered.`

`data`: the new device object.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 201 | Created |
| 400 | Invalid JSON or `code` not `GUN-n` |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 403 | Signed in but not IT/admin |
| 409 | Code or serial already used |

### Allocate device

`PATCH /hardware/devices/:id/`

IT or any Admin area. Point the sticker at a person: “Amit, pick up device 3” is `assigned_user_id` on `GUN-03`. Also used to rename the sticker `code`, set home warehouse, or mark `repair` / `retired`.

Omit a field to leave it unchanged. Set `assigned_user_id` to `null` to clear the allocation.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `GUN-03` or Zebra serial |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `assigned_user_id` | no | RBAC user PK, or null to clear |
| `code` | no | New sticker code (`GUN-03`) |
| `nickname` | no | Display / BT name |
| `home_location_id` | no | Home warehouse |
| `serial` | no | Bind Zebra serial |
| `status` | no | `active`, `repair`, `retired` |

### Response body

`message`: `Device updated.`

`data`: the updated device object.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Updated |
| 400 | Invalid JSON, bad `code`/`status`, or empty patch |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 403 | Signed in but not IT/admin |
| 404 | Device or user not found |
| 409 | Code or serial already used |

### List usage

`GET /hardware/usage/`

IT or any Admin area. Company-wide trail: who logged in or scanned on which gun, at which warehouse, when. Filter by sticker code, serial, user, site, or date range.

Stock receipts/transfers also store `device_serial` (and resolved `device_code`) on `stock_entry` when the gun sent the header.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | no | Sticker `GUN-01` |
| `serial` | no | Zebra serial |
| `device` | no | Code or serial |
| `user_id` | no | RBAC user PK |
| `location_id` | no | Warehouse at event time |
| `from` | no | ISO datetime (inclusive) |
| `to` | no | ISO datetime (inclusive) |
| `limit` | no | Page size, default 50, max 200 |
| `offset` | no | Skip N rows |

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Device usage fetched.`

`data.items[]`: `action` (`enroll` / `login` / `scan` / `allocate`), `device_code`, `device_serial`, `username`, `location_id`, `at`.

`data.count`, `data.limit`, `data.offset` for paging.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | List returned |
| 400 | Bad datetime / limit / offset |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 403 | Signed in but not IT/admin |

item.name: Device feed
item.description:
Instagram-style posts on a gun: photo/video, caption, who posted, when.

**Table:** `hw_device_post`

**Vars:** `{{id_token}}`, `{{device_code}}`, `{{post_id}}`

`cover_url` on the device card is the newest post. Refetch URLs; they expire in about an hour.

request.description:
### List company feed

`GET /hardware/feed/`

Any signed-in user. Newest posts first across every gun — the admin website wall. Filter by sticker, user, or date when you want one person’s or one gun’s history.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `code` or `device` | no | Sticker or serial |
| `user_id` | no | Who posted |
| `from` | no | ISO datetime inclusive |
| `to` | no | ISO datetime inclusive |
| `limit` | no | Default 50, max 200 |
| `offset` | no | Skip N rows |

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Device feed fetched.`

`data.items[]`:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | Post PK |
| `media_url` | Presigned image/video (~1h) |
| `kind` | `image` or `video` |
| `caption` | Text |
| `username` / `display_name` / `user_photo_url` | Who posted |
| `device_code` / `device_nickname` | Which gun |
| `created_at` | ISO datetime |

`data.count`, `data.limit`, `data.offset`.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | List returned |
| 400 | Bad datetime / paging |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 404 | `code` does not match a gun |

### List device posts

`GET /hardware/devices/:id/posts/`

Any signed-in user. Timeline for one gun (same shape as the company feed, filtered to this sticker).

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `GUN-01` or Zebra serial |

### Query parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | no | Default 50, max 200 |
| `offset` | no | Skip N rows |

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Device posts fetched.`

`data.items[]` same fields as company feed. `data.count` / `limit` / `offset`.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | List returned |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 404 | Unknown device |

### Create device post

`POST /hardware/devices/:id/posts/`

Any signed-in user. Multipart upload of a photo or short video onto this gun’s feed (who / when is taken from the login). The newest post becomes `cover_url` on the device card.

Images are converted to compressed WebP before S3 (`Hardware/{code}/post-{uuid}.webp`). EXIF is stored on the post as `metadata` (GPS stripped) and as S3 object metadata (`width`, `height`, `original-format`). Videos are stored as uploaded.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `GUN-01` or Zebra serial |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

`multipart/form-data`

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `file` (or `image`) | yes | JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV, or WebM. Max 20 MB |
| `caption` | no | Text, max 512 chars |

### Response body

`message`: `Device post created.`

`data`: the post object (`id`, `media_url`, `kind`, `content_type` (`image/webp` for photos), `metadata` JSON, `caption`, `username`, `created_at`, `device_code`).

`metadata`: `original_format`, `original_bytes`, `stored_format`, `stored_bytes`, `width`, `height`, `quality`, `exif`.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 201 | Created |
| 400 | Missing/invalid file |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 404 | Unknown device |

formdata.description: JPEG / PNG / WebP / GIF / MP4 / MOV / WebM

request.description:
### Delete device post

`DELETE /hardware/devices/:id/posts/:post_id/`

Author or IT/admin. Removes the post and best-effort deletes the S3 object. The next-newest post becomes the card `cover_url`.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `GUN-01` or Zebra serial |
| `post_id` | yes | Post PK (`{{post_id}}`) |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Device post deleted.`

`data.id`: the deleted post PK.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Deleted |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 403 | Not the author and not admin |
| 404 | Device or post not found |

item.name: Live presence
item.description:
Guns phone home every ~15s. The website cannot open `last_ip`; presence and popups only work while the warehouse app is running.

**Tables:** `hw_device.last_screen` / `last_seen_at`, `hw_device_message`

**Vars:** `{{id_token}}`, `{{device_code}}`, `{{device_serial}}`, `{{message_id}}`

Heartbeat and ack require `X-Device-Serial`. Send/list messages are IT/admin.

request.description:
### Heartbeat

`POST /hardware/heartbeat/`

Warehouse app only (any signed-in user). Call every ~15s while the gun is open so the admin card can show green/amber/grey. Updates `last_seen_at`, `last_ip`, `last_screen`, and `last_user` from the JWT. Does **not** write a usage-log row (that would flood `hw_device_event`).

Admin PCs must not call this: missing `X-Device-Serial` is 400.

Pending admin messages ride back on `data.messages[]` (unacked, cap 20). The first return sets `delivered_at`.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `screen` | no | Current app screen. Typical: `idle`, `login`, `goods_in`, `goods_out`, `remaining`, `offline_queue` |

### Response body

`message`: `Heartbeat recorded.`

`data`: device object plus:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `presence` | `online` (< 30s), `idle` (< 5 min), `offline` |
| `last_screen` | Echo of the last reported screen |
| `messages[]` | Unacked inbox rows (`id`, `title`, `body`, `created_at`, `delivered_at`) |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Presence updated |
| 400 | Missing serial or invalid JSON |
| 401 | Not signed in |

### Send message

`POST /hardware/devices/:id/messages/`

IT or any Admin area. Queue a popup for that gun: “Go to bay 4”. The warehouse app picks it up on the next heartbeat and shows an Alert. It is **not** pushed into the device by IP.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `GUN-03` or Zebra serial |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | yes | Alert title, max 128 |
| `body` | no | Alert body, max 512 |

### Response body

`message`: `Message sent.`

`data`: the message (`id`, `title`, `body`, `created_by_username`, `created_at`, `delivered_at` null until heartbeat, `acked_at` null until operator OK).

Saves `{{message_id}}`.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 201 | Queued |
| 400 | Missing `title` or invalid JSON |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 403 | Signed in but not IT/admin |
| 404 | Unknown device |

### List messages

`GET /hardware/devices/:id/messages/`

IT or any Admin area. Newest first. Use `delivered_at` / `acked_at` to see whether the gun has shown the popup and whether the operator tapped OK.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `GUN-03` or Zebra serial |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Device messages fetched.`

`data[]`:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | Message PK |
| `title` / `body` | Popup text |
| `created_by_username` | Who sent it from the website |
| `created_at` | When queued |
| `delivered_at` | First heartbeat that returned it, or null |
| `acked_at` | Operator OK, or null |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | List returned |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 403 | Signed in but not IT/admin |
| 404 | Unknown device |

### Ack message

`POST /hardware/messages/:id/ack/`

Warehouse app (any signed-in user). Call when the operator taps OK on the Alert. The message must belong to the serial in `X-Device-Serial`. Idempotent if already acked.

After ack, later heartbeats omit this row from `data.messages`.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | Message PK (`{{message_id}}`) |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Message acknowledged.`

`data`: the message with `acked_at` set.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Acked |
| 400 | Missing `X-Device-Serial` |
| 401 | Not signed in |
| 404 | Unknown id, or serial does not own this message |

item.name: Warehouse app
item.description:
Version gate for `com.gazeboerp.warehouse` on the TC22F.

**GET** — no auth. App blocks if installed version is below `min_version`. Operators cannot sideload in kiosk mode.

**PUT** — CI only. `Authorization: Bearer {{app_version_token}}` (`APP_VERSION_API_TOKEN`, not a user login). Called after S3 APK upload with the `app.json` version. Sets `min_version` immediately so old builds show Update required until MDM installs the APK.

**Table:** `app_version`. **Env:** `APP_VERSION_API_TOKEN` (same value as the GitHub secret).

request.description:
### App version

`GET /app/version/?platform=android`

**No auth.** Warehouse app calls this on launch. If the installed version is below `min_version`, the kiosk screen blocks and tells the operator to hand the device to IT (they cannot sideload the APK themselves).

`min_version` comes from the last CI `PUT /app/version/`, or env `APP_MIN_VERSION_ANDROID` until CI has written a row.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `platform` | no | Defaults to `android`. Other values are 400 |

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `ok`

`data`:

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `min_version` | yes | Floor. App blocks if installed version is lower |
| `latest_version` | no | Unused in UI for now. Defaults to `min_version` |
| `message` | no | Overrides the default kiosk copy |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Version payload returned |
| 400 | Unknown `platform` |

### Set app version

`PUT /app/version/`

CI only (after S3 APK upload). **Not** a user JWT — `Authorization: Bearer {APP_VERSION_API_TOKEN}`. Same value as the GitHub secret `APP_VERSION_API_TOKEN` and server env `APP_VERSION_API_TOKEN`.

Sets `min_version` immediately. Old kiosk builds then show Update required until MDM installs the new APK. Bump `app.json` on each release or devices stay unblocked.

Until the secret and this endpoint exist, the CI step is skipped.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `platform` | no | Defaults to `android` |
| `min_version` | yes | Floor from `app.json`, e.g. `1.0.1` |
| `latest_version` | no | Defaults to `min_version` |
| `message` | no | Overrides kiosk copy |

### Response body

`message`: `ok`

`data`: same shape as GET (`min_version`, `latest_version`, `message`).

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Saved |
| 400 | Missing `min_version`, invalid JSON, or unknown platform |
| 401 | Missing or wrong token, or `APP_VERSION_API_TOKEN` unset on the server |
